items.raw_excerpt: Event organiser Bohm Presents announced on Tuesday (Sep 15) that Trevor Noah has added extra shows to his upcoming Asia tour, including one more performance in Singapore.
items.summary_en: Comedian Trevor Noah has added a new show in Singapore to his upcoming Asia tour. The extra performance is scheduled for November 2026. The show was added due to high demand from fans.

items.title_en: Trevor Noah adds second Singapore show to his Asia tour

items.raw_excerpt: Nottingham becomes one of the first cities nationally to take this action, its council leader said.
items.summary_en: Nottingham has introduced a ban on wearing balaclavas in the city centre. The council leader said the city is one of the first in the UK to take this action. The rule aims to make people feel safer in public spaces.
items.summary_ko: 노팅엄 시는 시내 중심부에서 복면 착용을 금지하는 조치를 도입했습니다. 시의장은 노팅엄이 이를 시행하는 영국 최초의 도시 중 하나라고 밝혔습니다. 이 규칙은 공공장소에서 사람들이 더 안전하게 느끼도록 하기 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: Balaclava ban comes into force in Nottingham city centre
items.title_ko: 노팅엄 시내에서 복면 착용 금지 시행
items.title_original: Balaclava ban comes into force in Nottingham city centre

items.raw_excerpt: A village chief candidate in New Taipei was released on NT$100,000 (US$3,145) and barred from leaving the country as prosecutors probe whether he attempted to illegally influence voters by giving out free haircuts and douhua.
items.summary_en: A village chief candidate in New Taipei is suspected of giving voters free haircuts and douhua, a sweet tofu dessert, to win votes. Prosecutors released him on bail of NT$100,000 and barred him from leaving the country while they investigate.
items.summary_ko: 신베이의 한 마을 이장 후보가 유권자에게 무료 이발과 두화(달콤한 두부 푸딩)를 제공해 표를 얻으려 한 혐의를 받고 있습니다. 검찰은 그를 10만 대만 달러(약 3천 달러)에 보석으로 풀어주고 출국을 금지했습니다. 조사는 계속 진행 중입니다.
items.title_en: Village chief candidate bailed in douhua vote-buying probe
items.title_ko: 두화와 무료 이발로 표를 노린 마을 이장 후보, 보석으로 석방
items.title_original: New Taipei village chief candidate bailed in douhua vote-buying probe

items.raw_excerpt: Up to 80,000 people are expected to attend the opening day of this year's National Ploughing Championships in Screggan, Co Offaly.
items.summary_en: Up to 80,000 people are expected to attend the first day of Ireland's National Ploughing Championships in Screggan, County Offaly. The annual event draws huge crowds to the rural village for competitions, food stalls and live entertainment.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 오펄리주 스크레간에서 열리는 전국 쟁기대회 개막일에 최대 8만 명의 방문객이 몰릴 것으로 예상된다. 매년 열리는 이 행사는 농촌 마을에 경연 대회, 음식 부스, 라이브 공연 등으로 큰 인기를 끌고 있다.
items.title_en: 80,000 expected at opening day of Ploughing Championships
items.title_ko: 전국 쟁기대회 개막일에 8만 명 방문 예상
items.title_original: 80,000 expected at opening day of Ploughing Championships

items.raw_excerpt: Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) said Tuesday that Taiwan is preparing to open a representative's office in Cebu, the Philippines.
items.summary_en: Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung said Tuesday that Taiwan is preparing to open a representative's office in Cebu, the Philippines.

items.raw_excerpt: Many roads in Hanoi remained jammed for 2-3 km as people got stuck during rush hours after rain eased from 9 a.m. on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Many roads in Hanoi stayed jammed for 2-3 kilometers after morning rain ended on Tuesday. Commuters got stuck during rush hour and had to push their bikes through deep water to reach work.
items.summary_ko: 화요일 아침 비가 그친 후에도 하노이의 많은 도로는 2~3km 정체를 보였습니다. 출근 시간대 시민들은 무릎 높이 물에 잠긴 도로를 어렵게 통과해야 했습니다.

items.title_ko: 하노이 출근길, 무릎 높이 물속에서 고장 난 자전거 밀고 가는 시민들
items.title_original: Hanoi commuters push stalled bikes through knee-deep water to get to work

items.raw_excerpt: Former Australian Test opener Ed Cowan believes the Big Bash League is already attracting the game's biggest star without private investment.
items.summary_en: Former Australian Test cricketer Ed Cowan says the Big Bash League is already drawing top talent without needing private investment. He warns that privatisation of the league could spiral out of control and hurt the game.
items.summary_ko: 전 호주 크리켓 대표팀 타자 에드 코원은 비그 Bash 리그가 사유화 없이도 최고 선수들을 끌어들이고 있다고 말했다. 그는 리그의 사유화가 통제 불능으로 치달아 경기를 해칠 수 있다고 경고했다.
items.title_en: Former Test opener warns Big Bash privatisation could spiral
items.title_ko: 전 호주 대표팀 타자, 비그 Bash 사유화가 통제 불능 될 수 있다고 경고
items.title_original: Cowan warns BBL privatisation could 'spiral out of control'

items.raw_excerpt: Even digitally confident Germans struggle with online government services, according to new research. In some cases, up to nine in 10 users in the country abandon digital application processes before reaching the end.
items.summary_en: New research shows that digitally confident Germans still struggle with online government services. In some cases, up to nine in ten users abandon the process before finishing. The study highlights how hard it is to use Germany's digital bureaucracy.
items.summary_ko: 최신 연구에 따르면 디지털에 익숙한 독일인들도 정부 온라인 서비스를 이용하는 데 어려움을 겪고 있다. 어떤 경우에는 10명 중 최대 9명이 절차를 끝내지 못한 채 중도에 포기하는 것으로 나타났다. 이번 조사는 독일 디지털 행정의 접근성 문제를 부각시킨다.
items.title_en: Many Germans give up on digital government services
items.title_ko: 독일인 10명 중 9명, 디지털 행정 서비스 중도 포기
items.title_original: Why so many people give up on Germany’s digital bureaucracy

items.raw_excerpt: The small South Island township of Haast would usually be steadily humming with whitebaiters ahead of a busy summer.
items.summary_en: A pub owner in the small South Island town of Haast is losing thousands of dollars due to a highway closure. The closure has cut off tourist traffic during the busy summer season.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 남섬 작은 마을 하스트의 펍 주인이 고속도로 폐쇄로 인해 수천 달러의 손해를 입고 있습니다. 폐쇄로 인해 바쁜 여름철 관광객들의 발길이 끊겼습니다.
items.title_en: Highway closure costs New Zealand pub owner thousands

items.raw_excerpt: Spain's Imserso cheap holiday scheme for retirees is open for applications again. Here's who can benefit, where you can go and how much it will cost you.
items.summary_en: Spain's government has opened applications for its Imserso holiday program. The scheme gives pensioners affordable trips to resorts and coastal towns. It helps older people travel and stay active.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 정부가 은퇴자들을 위한 Imserso 휴가 프로그램 신청을 받고 있습니다. 이 프로그램은 연금 수령자들에게 리조트와 해안 도시로의 저렴한 여행을 제공합니다. 고령자들이 여행하고 활동적으로 지낼 수 있도록 돕습니다.
items.title_en: Spain offers cheap holidays for retirees
items.title_ko: 스페인, 은퇴자 위한 저렴한 휴가 프로그램
items.title_original: Spain launches affordable holidays for pensioners for 2026/27

items.raw_excerpt: Austria's e-moped rules are due to change significantly in October, requiring riders to have registration, insurance and a driving licence. But the ÖAMTC warns that thousands of people may have no practical way to make their existing vehicles legal.
items.summary_en: Austria will change its e-moped rules in October. Riders will need registration, insurance, and a driving licence. The ÖAMTC says thousands of people may have no practical way to make their existing e-mopeds legal.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아의 전동 모페드 규칙이 10월부터 크게 바뀐다. 운전자는 등록과 보험, 운전면허를 필수로 갖춰야 한다. 오스트리아 자동차클럽은 수천 명이 기존 차량을 합법 상태로 바꿀 방법이 없을 수 있다고 우려한다.
items.title_en: Austria's e-moped rules change on October 1st, but many cannot comply
items.title_ko: 오스트리아 전동 모페드 규칙 10월 1일부터 변경, 수천 명 대응 어려울 듯
items.title_original: Austria's e-moped rules change on October 1st but thousands may be unable to comply

items.raw_excerpt: Upon moving to Norway, you may initially receive a D-number, which is a temporary identity number issued by the Norwegian Tax Agency. But how do you switch to a social security number – the fødselsnummer?
items.summary_en: Newcomers to Norway often receive a D-number, a temporary identity number from the Tax Agency. To get a permanent fødselsnummer, you need to update your residency status. This guide explains the steps to make the switch.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이에 새로 온 사람들은 보통 국세청에서 발급하는 임시 신분번호인 D번호를 받게 됩니다. 영구적인 fødselsnummer를 받으려면 거주 등록 상태를 변경해야 합니다. 이 가이드에서는 전환 절차를 안내합니다.
items.title_en: How to switch from a D-number to a fødselsnummer in Norway
items.title_ko: 노르웨이에서 D번호를 fødselsnummer로 전환하는 방법
items.title_original: How to switch from a D-number to a 'fødselsnummer' in Norway

items.raw_excerpt: For weeks, residents have endured scorching daytime temperatures and choking haze.
items.summary_en: Sarawak has suffered weeks of scorching daytime temperatures and thick haze. The hot, dry spell is expected to continue into next month as water levels keep dropping.
items.summary_ko: 사라왁 주민들은 수 주째 뜨거운 낮 기운과 짙은 스모그를 견뎌왔다. 폭염과 건조한 날씨는 다음 달까지 이어질 전망이며, 수위도 계속 떨어지고 있다.
items.title_en: Sarawak faces prolonged hot, dry weather with haze and falling water levels

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan High Speed Rail Corp. (THSRC) said Tuesday that more than 1,000 people applied for 15 driver openings in the first phase of its largest-ever recruitment drive.
items.summary_en: More than 1,000 people applied for 15 driver positions at Taiwan High Speed Rail. The company is running its largest-ever recruitment drive. The first phase shows strong interest in the transportation jobs.
items.summary_ko: 대만 고속철도가 역대 최대 규모 채용을 진행 중인 가운데, 기사 직군 15개.position에 1,000명 이상이 몰렸습니다. 이번 1단계 모집은 교통 분야 취업에 대한 높은 관심을 보여줍니다.

items.title_original: Over 1,000 apply for 15 new Taiwan High Speed Rail driver positions

items.raw_excerpt: From a travel chest to an informal word for school, this French word has several meanings.
items.summary_en: The French word 'bahut' has several meanings. It can mean a large travel chest or trunk. In informal speech, French people also use it to mean school.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스어 '바위트'에는 여러 가지 뜻이 있다. 큰 여행용 트렁크를 뜻하기도 하고, 일상 대화에서는 학교를 뜻하기도 한다.

items.raw_excerpt: Housing minister Elanor Boekholt-O’Sullivan has pledged to make information about property foundations accessible to home owners from next year, ending the current secrecy. At the moment the information, which is a key part of getting a mortgage, can only be accessed by estate agents and banks. Since April 1 a simple foundations check has become part of the big banks’ mortgage requirements but this is only done once buyers have made an offer. Foundations are graded A to E, with...
items.summary_en: The Dutch housing minister wants to make property foundation information available to homeowners starting next year. Right now, only estate agents and banks can see these reports, which are important for getting a mortgage. Since April, buyers must get a foundation check before their mortgage is approved.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 주택부 장관이 내년부터 주택 기초 보고서 정보를 모든 주택 소유자가 볼 수 있도록 공개하겠다고 발표했습니다. 현재는 부동산 중개인과 은행만 이 보고서를 볼 수 있습니다. 4월부터 주택 구매자는 담보 대출을 받기 전 기초 검사를 받아야 합니다.
items.title_en: Dutch minister to open up property foundation reports to all homeowners
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 장관, 주택 기초 보고서 정보 공개 약속
items.title_original: Minister pledges to end secrecy on property foundation reports

items.raw_excerpt: The number of people aged 100 or older in Japan reached a record high of 107,677 in September, climbing for the 56th consecutive year, health ministry data showed Tuesday. The total number of centenarians grew by 7,914 from the previous year, surpassing the 100,000 threshold for the first time. Women…
items.summary_en: Japan reached a record 107,677 centenarians in September. That is up for the 56th year in a row. More than half are women.
items.summary_ko: 일본 보건성 발표에 따르면 9월 기준 100세 이상 인구가 10만 7677명으로 사상 최대를 기록했다. 이는 56년 연속 증가한 수치로 10만 명을 넘어선 것은 이번이 처음이다.
items.title_en: Japan now has over 100,000 people aged 100 or older
items.title_ko: 일본 100세 이상 인구 10만 명 돌파
items.title_original: Number of centenarians in Japan tops 100,000 for 1st time

items.summary_en: A woman who was reported missing in Christchurch has been found safe and well. Police thanked the public for their help in locating her.

items.raw_excerpt: The 29th Taiwan-France Cultural Award has been presented to Tamkang University's Wu Hsi-deh (吳錫德) and Victor Louzon, an assistant professor of history at Sorbonne University.
items.summary_en: The 29th Taiwan-France Cultural Award has been presented to two academics. Wu Hsi-deh from Tamkang University and Victor Louzon from Sorbonne University received the honor.
